outcome.text: P2 fails above 1.35 on the models and pairs named, none below 0.97, and P3 holds as in A. The page reports P2 as failed and prints the cells wholly above 1.35. It scopes its statements that forward loops cost little or stay vectorized to loops bounded by `size()`: a sentence that names its models, on the models on which the sum failed; a sentence that names none, everywhere. It reports the census count beside the cost, with its unit and method (228 lost loops, a per-function count at 38 source locations, in a class assigned by a text pattern, with no knowledge of how often any of them runs, and with the share that has one of the six shapes not counted), and gives the writes as at or above 1.5x only for the cells whose interval lies at or above 1.5.
